item.title: [AAPL Bullish (+0.30), NVDA Bullish (+0.35), TSM Bullish (+0.48)] TSMC Revives Longtan for 1.4nm Fabs and CoWoS Hub as Both Sell Out Globally
item.category: AAPL Bullish (+0.30), NVDA Bullish (+0.35), TSM Bullish (+0.48)
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bullish (+0.30), NVDA Bullish (+0.35), TSM Bullish (+0.48)
TSMC is reportedly planning to build two to three 1.4nm fabrication plants and two advanced packaging facilities at the Longtan Phase 3 site in Taoyuan, Taiwan, after local opposition reversed. This site would uniquely house both next-generation logic production and CoWoS packaging capabilities, which are currently globally sold out and critical for AI accelerator chips. The plan, though facing remaining hurdles like land acquisition and environmental review, signifies Taiwan's effort to keep TSMC's most advanced technology anchored domestically amidst its global expansion.
